title: AN OVERVIEW OF MODEL UNCERTAINTY AND VARIABILITY IN LLM-BASED SENTIMENT ANALYSIS. CHALLENGES, MITIGATION STRATEGIES AND THE ROLE OF EXPLAINABILITY

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating inconsistencies and systematic leanings (e.g., positive or negative polarity bias) in model outputs by comparing numerical sentiment scores and categorical labels across repeated inference runs and different prompt structures.

Reviewing existing literature on how models inherit biases from training data, leading to systematic sentiment variations and misclassifications when analyzing content associated with different demographics, industries, or social groups.
Synthesizing literature on human-AI interactions to evaluate how user trust, algorithm aversion, and self-reinforcing feedback loops amplify subjective biases in aggregated sentiment classification.
